base_answer_meta.prompt_suffix: End your reply with a final line of the form 'Answer: ...'.
base_answer_meta.excerpt: last 400 characters of the reply, as recorded

prompt.note: PROMPTBOX family_test item 0 of cell cups|train|L1024 (seed 777)

program.note: PROMPTBOX's reference program for this item, written by its generator. It stands in for the step where the model writes the program; no model wrote it.

run.note: INTERP's frozen core (picert, seed 0, step 6,000) running the program's table, on this machine

answer.note: the program's answer line applied to the core's final state

base_answer.note: PROMPTBOX base-answer eval: the same question, no program

poke.note: the same core, resumed from a forced state

ablation.note: the same core with its head's output zeroed

program.text:
<program>
task: which spot hides the ball after the swaps
input: the swaps in order
events: LM MR LR
ball: left middle right
start: ball=left
on LM: ball left>middle middle>left
on MR: ball middle>right right>middle
on LR: ball left>right right>left
answer: Point at {ball}: the ball is there.
</program>

certificate.covers: every automaton with at most 256 states and 4 events in the core's vocabulary, on every input of every length (INTERP Theorems 1 and 2)

codebook.projection: the program's state codes, centred, on their top three principal directions; each step's point is the head's output y before the snap, in the same projection
